title: http: when unfolding, leave single-space for new header line
body:
Restore the unfolding behavior from before 67ae101666f10232. This change (leaving more whitespace in the delivered headers) turned out causing some friction in the git project so presumably others might also find it a little surprising.

Reported-by: Jeff King
Ref: https://marc.info/?l=git&m=176606332701171&w=2

files.patch:
@@ -55,7 +55,7 @@ Server: test-server/ fake folded
 Last-Modified: Tue, 13 Jun 2000 12:10:00 GMT
 ETag: "21025-dc7-39462498"
 Content-Length: 6
-Connection:%repeat[46 x  ]%   close
+Connection: close
 
 </file>
 </verify>

@@ -59,7 +59,7 @@ http://%HOSTIP:%HTTPPORT/%TESTNUMBER
 - Set-Cookie == onecookie=data; (0/3)
 - Set-Cookie == secondcookie=2data; (1/3)
 - Set-Cookie == cookie3=data3; (2/3)
- Fold == is folding a        line
+ Fold == is folding a line
  Blank ==%SP
  Blank2 ==%SP
 </stdout>
